name: Scuppernong Spectacular 2019

venue.name: [Lee Park Baptist Church](http://leeparkchurch.org/)
venue.address: 2505 Morgan Mill Rd, Monroe, North Carolina 28110

information:
Registration includes a shirt. **Please include your shirt size in the comment section of registration.** If you fail to do so, you will not get a shirt
Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us.
All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.
Registrations must be manually approved, please wait up to 48 hours to appear on the competitor's list.
